description: Create an own template of the workspace from scratch, e.g. a project template for a kind of client work with its board columns, fields and starter tasks. kind project (default) or workspace (administrators). A template is { name, projects: [project] } (a project template has exactly one project). project = { name, key?, icon? (one emoji), desc?, start?/end? (days from the day it is used), statuses?: [{name, category: backlog|todo|in_progress|in_review|done|canceled}] (empty = the 6 base statuses), fields?: [{name, type: text|number|money|payments|date|select|multi|url|person|checkbox|formula, options?, currency? (money, payments: UAH, USD, EUR...), formula? (formula fields), on_card?}], milestones?: [{name, due? (days)}], issues?: [{title, desc?, status? (a status name, or a kind without own statuses), priority?: none|urgent|high|medium|low, labels?: [], due? (days), ms? (index into milestones)}], checklists?: [{issue (index into issues), title, items: []}], parent? (index of another project of the template: a sub-project, at most 3 levels; a project template has one top project) }.

kind.description: project = a template for one project, workspace = a set of projects

name.description: template name, e.g. "Landing page for a client"

projects.description: the projects; default one empty project named like the template

name: create_template
